integrity: The result is derived and checked by explicit binomial identities and Lucas parity. Finite computations corroborate but do not prove the infinite-family theorem. There has been no independent review or certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is about the null-filiform one-generator family, not arbitrary Zinbiel algebras. Although directly inspected literature does not give the stated characteristic-two Lie centre, indirect prior implication remains a bounded originality risk. Characteristic-independent source results need not assert this modular claim.
title: A binary popcount law for the centre of Zinbiel derivation Lie algebras
